The study is designed to test both symptomatic (6 months) and disease-modifying (18 months) effects of buntanetap. · Timeline : The Company plans a database lock for the 6-month analysis in Q1 2027, with the top-line symptomatic data readout anticipated in the same quarter.
The disease-modifying data readout is expected a year later.
